p: bay that looketh southward: The Hebrew word signifies tongue, by which it means either the arm of the sea that comes into the land, or a rock, or cape that goes into the sea.
end of Jordan: Meaning the mouth of the river where it runs into the Salt sea.
stone of Bohan the son of: Which was a mark to part their countries.
drove thence the three sons of: This was done after the death of Joshua, Jud 1:10,20.
and she lighted off her ass: Because her husband tarried too long.
give me also springs of water: Because her country was barren, she wanted a field that had springs from her father. Jud 1:14,15.
Hormah: Which before was called Zephath, Jud 1:17.
river of Egypt: Meaning, the Nile Jos 13:3.
Kirjathsannah: Which is also called Kirjath-sepher, Jos 15:15.
city of Salt: Of this city the salt sea has it's name.
out: That is, utterly, though they slew the most part, and burnt their city, Jud 1:8.
